content.text: Return a concise event object for a local Rust meetup in Seattle.

tools.name: final_result
tools.description: Call this tool exactly once with your final answer when you are done. Its arguments are the structured result and must satisfy the output schema.

arguments.title: Seattle Rust Meetup — Monthly
arguments.summary: When: 2nd Tuesday of each month, 7:00–9:00 PM. Where: Impact Hub Seattle (220 2nd Ave S) — community room. Format: 15 min check-in, 45 min featured talk, ~20 min lightning talks/announcements, then open help & networking. Audience: Rust developers and learners of all levels. Bring laptop; having Rust installed is recommended. Cost: free (donation welcome). RSVP/Info: meetup.com/seattle-rust or seattle-rust@community.org.
